messages:
jo: Quick PR incoming: tiny tool-calling example + one-line JSON Schema and two SDK snippets. Need fast link + wording check.

lee: include a null-return case and an error case for the tool. reviewers expect both.

jo: draft flow (very small):
```
User: 'Price for sku 123'
Assistant -> call price_lookup(sku=123)
Tool: {\"price_cents\":1999, \"currency\":\"USD\"}
Assistant final: {\"price_display\":\"$19.99\"}
```

sam: add this compact JSON Schema inline: {\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"price_cents\":{\"type\":[\"integer\",\"null\"]},\"currency\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"currency\"]} and a note: price_cents may be null on tool failure.

lee: JS hint: const parsed = Responses.parseStructured(resp) // docs helper; Python hint: parsed = validate_structured(resp). Also avoid wording that implies the runtime enforces the schema  state validation is client-side.

docbot: docs-ci: "staging build passed (lint + linkcheck)"

jo: pushed and merged. I'll open a follow-up to expand runbook examples and canonical shims. :thumbsup:
